one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never wrote results to the required /app/solution.txt, instead saving all solutions to .npy files, and the objective function omitted the L2 regularization term used by the evaluator, violating both the submission contract and evaluation criteria despite finding a numerically feasible candidate.
t_err_evidence: Step 3 creates optimize_factory.py that saves solution to 'optimal_solution.npy' instead of the required /app/solution.txt; the spec requirement for the output artifact is never addressed throughout the trajectory.
t_commit_evidence: Step 11 runs optimize_factory_v3.py which finds a feasible solution (sum~500, cost~1560) and saves it to optimal_solution_v3.npy; the agent then declares success and all subsequent steps merely validate or try to refine this .npy-stored solution without ever writing /app/solution.txt.
trigger_explanation: The agent never checks the task specification for required output format and assumes saving to a .npy file is sufficient; it also independently reconstructs the cost function without the L2 regularization term that the evaluator uses in its gradient check, indicating the agent never read or applied the full problem specification.
